Project Maya

GLM-5.3-Flash (321 B), DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 (748 B) and MiniMax-M3.1-Flash (428 B) on your own GPU
private and fast · one NVIDIA GPU or up to 16 · AMD and Windows (experimental) · chat, pictures, OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible API · several requests at once

Created and led by Peasant Smith (@mw00), co-maintained with @needmorevram


Project Maya is free. If it runs well on your PC, sponsoring it pays for the test hardware and the work on it.

Models this size usually need a datacenter. Maya runs three of them on the hardware you already have: **GLM-5.3-Flash**, **DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017** and **MiniMax-M3.1-Flash**. Each model has an architecture-specific path in the shared backend. It keeps the experts your conversation uses most on the GPU, the next ones in RAM and the rest on your NVMe SSD, and moves them as you chat. It measures your GPUs, CPU, RAM and SSD and tunes itself to them. Nothing leaves your machine. - **Fast:** up to 149 tokens/s on two RTX 5090s and an RTX 4090, 124 on two H100s, 118 on four RTX 4090s, 81 on one RTX PRO 6000, 30+ on a single RTX 5090. [Real numbers from real users](#how-fast-is-it). - **NVIDIA and AMD together:** one CUDA primary and an AMD HIP expert helper serve the same model through one process. Validated pairing: **RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell 96 GB + Radeon PRO W7800 48 GB**. See [One CUDA backend](#one-cuda-backend-three-model-families-windows). - **Close to the original:** Maya's own quants of GLM-5.3-Flash keep 97.7-99.2% of the FP8 model's zero-shot accuracy; DeepSeek V4.1 · Maya-S picks the same next token as the original 92.6% of the time, MiniMax M3.1 · Maya-S 87.6% (the average over its categories). - **Plugs into your tools:** OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible API with tool calls, ready for coding agents. - **Several requests at once:** up to 8 answered together with GLM-5.3-Flash, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash and MiniMax-M3.1-Flash - for agents that run several sessions, or several people on one PC. - **Everything in the box:** a chat and a live monitor in the browser, pictures, thinking levels, a one-command setup. ## Quick start ```sh git clone https://github.com/mw00/project-maya.git && cd project-maya ./setup.sh ``` The setup asks which model you want, downloads it, builds everything once and **starts the model**. Then open `http://127.0.0.1:8080`. Windows: `START-MAYA.bat` instead of `./setup.sh`. More in [Install](#install). ## Pick your model Every Maya quant is named after its model, then its tier - XS, S, M or L, by how many bits its experts keep. The setup recommends one for your PC; to pick one yourself, give its setup id: `./setup.sh --model glm-maya-s24`. | Model | Maya quant · setup id | Size | Made for | | --- | --- | ---: | --- | | **[GLM-5.3-Flash](https://huggingface.co/zai-org/GLM-5.3-Flash)**

The setup also offers unsloth's GGUF and LibertAIDAI's EXL3 quants of DeepSeek, orcarouter's abliterated DeepSeek, Mia-AiLab's EXL3 quant of MiniMax, turboderp's EXL3 quants of GLM, and Qwen-3.8-Flash-Next (CYBER-FROST) as its Q5_K_M GGUF, with pictures ([its settings](docs/SETTINGS.md#qwen-38-flash-next-cyber-frost)). **Each model's files, drafters, pictures and options: [docs/MODELS.md](docs/MODELS.md).** ## Quality Maya's quants are made from each model's released weights and measured against the original: - **GLM-5.3 · Maya quants** keep 97.7-99.2% of the FP8 model's zero-shot accuracy and pick its next token 83-90% of the time (Maya-L: 99.2%, 90%). How they're made and measured: [MAYA-S](bench/results/MAYA-S.md), [MAYA-S24](bench/results/MAYA-S24.md), [MAYA-M](bench/results/MAYA-M.md), [MAYA-L](bench/results/MAYA-L.md). - **DeepSeek V4.1 · Maya-S** picks the same next token as the original 92.6% of the time. - **MiniMax M3.1 · Maya-S** picks it 87.6% of the time (the average over its categories). More on each model's card on [Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/peasantsmith). ## How fast is it? Real machines measured by our users, most with `./maya.sh --bench` (decode: three greedy 256-token answers; prefill: an 8K-token prompt unless the row says otherwise). Share yours: `--bench`, then `--report`, in a [GitHub issue](https://github.com/mw00/project-maya/issues).

size_t g_up = 0; // (the load's upload_mat / upload_f32 bytes so far: the Monitor's dense weights) // a GGUF's matrix (pack_gguf.py: 
.weight, [n][k] in a ggml block type) onto the device as it is stored
x3::Mat upload_gg(const Tensor& t, const Pack& pk, const std::string& pre, std::vector& owned, std::string& err) {
    x3::Mat m;
    const int ty = gg::type_of(t.dtype);
    if (t.shape.size() != 2 || !gg::dense_type(ty)) {
        err = pre + ": a " + t.dtype + " tensor the GGUF kernels do not take as a matrix";
        return m;
    }
    m.fmt = gg::kFmtGG;
    m.gg_type = ty;
    m.n = (int) t.shape[0];
    m.k = (int) t.shape[1];
    const size_t rb = gg::row_bytes(ty, m.k);
    if (rb == 0 || t.bytes != rb * (size_t) m.n || m.k % 256 != 0) {
        err = pre + ": " + std::to_string(t.bytes) + " bytes for [" + std::to_string(m.n) + "][" + std::to_string(m.k) +
              "] " + t.dtype;
        return m;
    }
    m.ld = (int) rb;
    void* d = nullptr;
    if (cudaMalloc(&d, t.bytes) != cudaSuccess) {
        err = pre + ": out of device memory";
        return m;
    }
    owned.push_back(d);
    g_up += t.bytes;
    cudaMemcpy(d, pk.data(t), t.bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice);
    m.raw = d;
    return m;
}

x3::Mat upload_mat(const Pack& pk, const std::string& pre, std::vector& owned, std::string& err) {
    x3::Mat m;
    if (const Tensor* w = pk.get(pre + ".weight"); w != nullptr && gg::type_of(w->dtype) > 0)
        return upload_gg(*w, pk, pre, owned, err);
    const Tensor* tr = pk.get(pre + ".trellis");
    const Tensor* su = pk.get(pre + ".suh");
    const Tensor* sv = pk.get(pre + ".svh");
    if (!tr || !su || !sv || !pk.get(pre + ".mul1") || tr->shape.size() != 3) {
        err = pre + ": not an EXL3 (mul1) matrix";
        return m;
    }
    void *dt = nullptr, *ds = nullptr, *dv = nullptr;
    if (cudaMalloc(&dt, tr->bytes) != cudaSuccess || cudaMalloc(&ds, su->bytes) != cudaSuccess ||
        cudaMalloc(&dv, sv->bytes) != cudaSuccess) {
        err = pre + ": out of device memory";
        return m;
    }
    owned.insert(owned.end(), {dt, ds, dv});
    g_up += tr->bytes + su->bytes + sv->bytes;
    cudaMemcpy(dt, pk.data(*tr), tr->bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice);
    cudaMemcpy(ds, pk.data(*su), su->bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice);
    cudaMemcpy(dv, pk.data(*sv), sv->bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice);
    m.trellis = (const uint32_t*) dt;
    m.suh = (const uint16_t*) ds;
    m.svh = (const uint16_t*) dv;
    m.k = (int) (su->bytes / 2);
    m.n = (int) (sv->bytes / 2);
    m.k2 = (int) tr->shape[2] / 8;
    m.cb = 2;
    if (!x3::supported(m)) err = pre + ": shape / bits not covered by the EXL3 kernels";
    return m;
}

// a tensor's stored bytes on the device as they are (a GGUF's Q8_0 indexer projections: k::rows_dot_q8's blocks)
const uint8_t* upload_raw(const Pack& pk, const std::string& name, std::vector& owned, std::string& err) {
    const Tensor* t = pk.get(name);
    if (!t) {
        err = name + ": missing";
        return nullptr;
    }
    void* dp = nullptr;
    if (cudaMalloc(&dp, t->bytes) != cudaSuccess) {
        err = name + ": out of device memory";
        return nullptr;
    }
    owned.push_back(dp);
    g_up += t->bytes;
    cudaMemcpy(dp, pk.data(*t), t->bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice);
    return (const uint8_t*) dp;
}

// a float vector on the device: the stored F32 / F16 / BF16 tensor (+ add to every value); a GGUF's Q8_0 (the
// indexer's projections) dequantized exactly - ggml's value, an F16 scale times an int8
float* upload_f32(const Pack& pk, const std::string& name, float add, std::vector& owned, size_t& n,
                  std::string& err) {
    const Tensor* t = pk.get(name);
    if (!t) {
        err = name + ": missing";
        return nullptr;
    }
    const bool q8 = t->dtype == "Q8_0";
    const size_t es = t->dtype == "F32" ? 4 : 2;
    n = q8 ? t->bytes / 34 * 32 : t->bytes / es;
    std::vector h(n);
    const uint8_t* d = pk.data(*t);
    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        float v;
        if (q8) {
            const uint8_t* b = d + i / 32 * 34;
            v = gg::host_f16((uint16_t) (b[0] | b[1] << 8)) * (float) (int8_t) b[2 + i % 32];
        } else if (t->dtype == "F32") {
            std::memcpy(&v, d + 4 * i, 4);
        } else if (t->dtype == "BF16") {
            uint16_t b;
            std::memcpy(&b, d + 2 * i, 2);
            const uint32_t u = (uint32_t) b << 16;
            std::memcpy(&v, &u, 4);
        } else if (t->dtype == "F16") {
            uint16_t b;
            std::memcpy(&b, d + 2 * i, 2);
            // FP16 -> F32
            const uint32_t s = (uint32_t) (b & 0x8000) << 16, e = (b >> 10) & 0x1f, m = b & 0x3ff;
            uint32_t u;
            if (e == 0) {
                if (m == 0) {
                    u = s;
                } else {   // subnormal
                    float f = (float) m / 1024.0f / 16384.0f;
                    std::memcpy(&u, &f, 4);
                    u |= s;
                }
            } else if (e == 31) {
                u = s | 0x7f800000u | (m << 13);
            } else {
                u = s | ((e + 112) << 23) | (m << 13);
            }
            std::memcpy(&v, &u, 4);
        } else {
            err = name + ": dtype " + t->dtype;
            return nullptr;
        }
        h[i] = v + add;
    }
    void* dp = nullptr;
    if (cudaMalloc(&dp, n * 4) != cudaSuccess) {
        err = name + ": out of device memory";
        return nullptr;
    }
    owned.push_back(dp);
    g_up += n * 4;
    cudaMemcpy(dp, h.data(), n * 4, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice);
    return (float*) dp;
}

// the prefill calibration's key of this PC: the GPUs (name, architecture, memory), the GPU runtime and driver - a
// calibration measured elsewhere (another GPU, a new driver) is not taken
std::string tune_key_of(const std::vector& gpus) {
    std::string k = "mm3-prefill-1";
    for (int id : gpus) {
        cudaDeviceProp pr{};
        if (cudaGetDeviceProperties(&pr, id) != cudaSuccess) continue;
#if defined(STRATA_USE_HIP)
        std::string arch = pr.gcnArchName;
        if (arch.find(':') != std::string::npos) arch.resize(arch.find(':'));
#else
        const std::string arch = "sm_" + std::to_string(pr.major) + std::to_string(pr.minor);
#endif
        std::string name = pr.name;
        for (char& c : name)
            if (c == '\t' || c == '\n' || c == '|') c = ' ';
        k += "|" + name + " " + arch + " " + std::to_string((pr.totalGlobalMem + (1u << 29)) >> 30) + "GB";
    }
    int rt = 0, drv = 0;
    cudaRuntimeGetVersion(&rt);
    cudaDriverGetVersion(&drv);
    return k + "|rt" + std::to_string(rt) + "|drv" + std::to_string(drv);
}

    bool expert_layout_gg(Layer& l, int li, std::string& err) {
        const std::string E = P + "layers." + std::to_string(li) + ".block_sparse_moe.experts.";
        const char* parts[3] = {"w1", "w3", "w2"};
        l.src.assign((size_t) g.n_exp, {});
        size_t off = 0;
        for (int r = 0; r < 3; ++r) {
            const int n = r < 2 ? g.ff : g.dim, k = r < 2 ? g.dim : g.ff;
            const Tensor* t0 = pk.get(E + "0." + parts[r] + ".weight");
            const int ty = t0 ? gg::type_of(t0->dtype) : -1;
            const size_t bytes = (size_t) n * gg::row_bytes(ty, k);
            if (t0 == nullptr || !gg::expert_type(ty) || bytes == 0 || t0->bytes != bytes) {
                err = E + "0." + parts[r] + ": not a [" + std::to_string(n) + "][" + std::to_string(k) +
                      "] expert matrix the GGUF kernels take (" + (t0 ? t0->dtype : std::string("missing")) + ")";
                return false;
            }
            for (int e = 0; e < g.n_exp; ++e) {
                const Tensor* t = pk.get(E + std::to_string(e) + "." + parts[r] + ".weight");
                if (t == nullptr || t->dtype != t0->dtype || t->bytes != bytes) {
                    err = E + std::to_string(e) + "." + parts[r] + ": missing, or not expert 0's type and size";
                    return false;
                }
                Src& s = l.src[(size_t) e];
                s.p[r * 3] = pk.data(*t);
                s.n[r * 3] = bytes;
                for (int q = 1; q < 3; ++q) {
                    s.p[r * 3 + q] = nullptr;
                    s.n[r * 3 + q] = 0;
                }
            }
            l.lay.trellis[r] = l.lay.suh[r] = l.lay.svh[r] = off;
            l.lay.gg_type[r] = ty;
            l.lay.k2[r] = 0;
            off += up(bytes);
        }
        l.lay.fmt = gg::kFmtGG;
        l.lay.cb = 0;
        l.blob = off;
        if (o.cpu_threads >= 0 && !gg_fmt(l.lay.gg_type[0], l.lay.gg_type[1], l.lay.gg_type[2], g.dim, g.ff, l.gf, err)) {
            // (a build without ggml-cpu, or a type it has no dot for: the experts outside VRAM are staged instead)
            info.push_back("NOTE: no CPU lane - layer " + std::to_string(li) + "'s experts: " + err);
            std::fprintf(stderr, "maya-mm3: %s\n", info.back().c_str());
            err.clear();
            o.cpu_threads = -1;
        }
        return true;
    }

        const char* parts[3] = {"w1", "w3", "w2"};   // gate, up, down

        for (int e = 0; e < g.n_exp; ++e) {

                for (int q = 0; q < 3; ++q) {
                    const Tensor* t = pk.get(E + std::to_string(e) + "." + parts[r] + pieces[q]);
                    if (!t) {
                        err = E + std::to_string(e) + "." + parts[r] + pieces[q] + ": missing";
                        return false;

                    l.src[(size_t) e].n[r * 3 + q] = t->bytes;
                    if (e == 0) {

                        } else if (q == 1) {
